name: @u1f992/pdfdiff
description: Visualize and quantify differences between two PDF files.

scripts.lint: tsc --project tsconfig.tools.json && oxlint --fix src tests scripts && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: tsc --project tsconfig.tools.json && oxfmt src tests scripts && npm run format --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:wasm: docker run --rm --volume .:/workdir --workdir /workdir --user root --entrypoint bash emscripten/emsdk:6.0.11 scripts/build-wasm.sh
scripts.format:wasm: docker run --rm --volume .:/workdir --workdir /workdir --user root --entrypoint bash emscripten/emsdk:6.0.11 scripts/build-wasm.sh format
scripts.tidy:wasm: docker run --rm --volume .:/workdir --workdir /workdir --user root --entrypoint bash emscripten/emsdk:6.0.11 scripts/build-wasm.sh tidy
scripts.clean:wasm: docker run --rm --volume .:/workdir --workdir /workdir --user root --entrypoint bash emscripten/emsdk:6.0.11 scripts/build-wasm.sh clean
scripts.build:lib: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp -r src/wasm dist/wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:version && npm run build:lib

author: Koutaro Mukai
